android.desc:
Argument AI helps two to four people examine a disagreement by collecting each participant's perspective and producing structured, AI-generated analysis. Use it with partners, family members, friends, roommates, coworkers, or business partners when you want to compare viewpoints and consider practical next steps.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create a session and share its six-character code or invitation link.
2. Other participants join from their own devices.
3. Each person presents their perspective by typing or speaking, using the same response limits.
4. When additional context is useful, the AI asks follow-up questions.
5. Review an AI-generated assessment that compares the submitted viewpoints, explains key points, and suggests possible next steps.

FEATURES

• Sessions for 2–4 participants
• Separate submissions so each person can explain their viewpoint
• AI-generated analysis of the reasoning and information provided
• Follow-up questions when more context is needed
• A percentage comparison and explanation of the result
• Suggestions for compromise, communication, and de-escalation
• Private feedback about the strengths and weaknesses of your own submission
• Voice input with transcription
• Argument history and PDF export
• Support for 11 languages, including analysis in the selected language

ACCESS OPTIONS

Argument AI is available free with daily limits. A one-time seven-day Pro trial requires no payment details. Optional Plus and Pro subscriptions provide higher limits and additional features, including longer responses, voice input, more participants, and expanded guidance. A Session Pass can unlock one argument without a subscription. Subscriptions are billed through Google Play and renew automatically until cancelled.

PRIVACY

Voice input is transcribed to create the session text, and recordings are deleted after transcription. The app does not sell personal data or use cross-app advertising tracking. You can delete your account and associated data from within the app. See the privacy policy for complete details.

IMPORTANT

Argument AI provides AI-generated perspectives based only on the information participants submit. Results may be incomplete or inaccurate and should not be treated as objective fact. The app is intended for reflection, entertainment, and better conversations. It does not provide legal, medical, psychological, financial, or other professional advice.

Terms: https://argumentapp.ai/terms
